accounting.source_reading_costs: If any source is inspected by an authored worker, charge exact exposed bytes equally or report the asymmetry. Selection itself must not read source bodies.

factors.interpretation: Visibility and byte-budget change; not measured model utility.
factors.name: summary_layout

factors.baseline: Existing exact path/function/kind query, stopping once the nominated row appears; charge incidental rows and continuation envelopes.
factors.common_input: Same new visible hint IDs and source-replayed report population for both selectors.
factors.interpretation: Isolates exact-ID selector effect under equal hint information. Unique-match cases may show no benefit and must remain in the report.
factors.name: retrieval_selector
factors.treatment: Exact path/obligation-ID query for the same complete native row.

factors.baseline: Unfiltered full scan of all105 rows with production response budgets
factors.interpretation: Do not present selective-vs-exhaustive byte reduction as an advantage over existing filtered retrieval.
factors.name: exhaustive_inventory

factors.baseline: Historical summary plus old-filter discovery pages needed to obtain nominated rows
factors.interpretation: Report summary cost and any discovery cost explicitly. A row ID derived from the new summary cannot be treated as free information available in the historical arm.
factors.name: combined_discovery_and_fetch

integration_audit.planner: terminal_initial_context appends the whole summary; prompt_goal_planner._frozen_summary_map preserves nested maps/lists or refuses depth>6, maps>64, sequence>256, unsafe strings, or total budget.
integration_audit.remaining_risk: Real router request construction, task-bundle loading and compiled-worker dispatch must be exercised; direct _summary tests cannot prove delivery.
integration_audit.role_context_selection: Wraps native semantic source/capsule selection; numerical hints are independently bound through task formalization evidence. No nested numerical field whitelist found here.
integration_audit.worker: task_context_bundle._worker_evidence retains complete validated summary <=8192B. ContextCompiler carries the JSON as required source-formalization text chunks. source_formalization_context._parts reconstructs exact bytes and checks canonical required6144-byte chunks plus current owner selection.

required_regressions: Actual authored planner callback sees byte-equivalent numerical summary before canonical goals/tasks exist.
After real plan admission, task bundle worker evidence retains identical hint rows, omission counts and unverified-scope envelope.
Actual authored coding router callback reconstructs formalization evidence via _parts and sees every selected ID and scope flag.
Fetch selected IDs through actual client/broker session; complete rows equal owner rows including all guarded/CFG/proof scope fields.
Unknown or cross-source IDs return no row; malformed/oversized selectors refuse; exact ID intersects function/kind filters rather than bypassing them.
Changing ID invalidates old cursor; no-ID legacy query serialization remains unchanged if compatibility promises require it.
Current-source edit invalidates ID fetch; restore recovers; source/report/summary digests are replayed.
Generated summary stays within planner depth and mapping bounds for short and long identifiers; omission totals remain exact.
Missing mandatory required-context chunks refuse rather than silently dropping hints.
No assertion of discharged obligations, invariant/termination truth, learned coverage, task success or token savings.
scope: Authored provider-free selection over public instruction and planner-visible metadata. No hidden verifier, benchmark solution, source execution, provider/model inference, training, or proof discharge.

selection_policy.function_filter: Use the first lexically sorted function_id on the selected hint, plus its exact kind and path.
selection_policy.loop_scenarios: First visible loop-proof hint per proof phase in eval.py; instruction references public evaluation and median runtime. These are inspection examples, not asserted performance invariants.
selection_policy.missing_hints: Record each absent scenario as not selectable; never discover IDs by inspecting full reports.
selection_policy.residual_scenarios: First visible eigenpair_residual hint in each public source path; instruction explicitly requires the eigenpair residual.
selection_policy.target_fallback: If no residual hint is exposed for eigen.py, inspect the first visible eigen.py hint because the instruction names that entrypoint; never fetch a hidden full-row ID for selection.
selection_policy.tie_break: visible hint order, then path/function/kind/ID lexical order where grouping is needed
